algorithm: in the propagation pass, for a puzhu:21 edge whose target context is in eligibleContexts:
cancelled = the 卷十 subject scopes whose state on each fired trigger is neither_recorded
remaining = target trace.ji minus cancelled; protected 忌 keep blocking as today
remaining empty -> current behaviour (lift); else keep ji, state only_ji (both_present if 宜 noted)
every other edge, line and context: unchanged (N-A)

options.A_rule_filter_with_allowlist: contribution filter on puzhu:21 edges, gated by the authority allowlist (recommended: smallest change that encodes the semantic, auditable allowlist, one rollback policy)
options.B_context_overlay: authority lists (context, heading) -> only_ji: smallest diff but encodes the output, not the semantic; drifts if other rules move
options.C_global_filter_with_blocklist: filter on every puzhu:21 edge, block HOLD/QUARANTINE contexts: fails open for new contexts; rejected

provenance: trace keeps 五離 in ji; add propagatedFrom and a cancelled list for puzhu:21 rows
migrationDiff: every changed row must be a MIGRATE date; activity and event deltas must equal impact.json MIGRATION_ELIGIBLE_ONLY; any HOLD/QUARANTINE date diff fails
rollback: authority successor + test-only rollback module, as F1 (f1R2Rollback.ts) and Q4-REST (q4RestRollback.ts): p21Rollback.ts mocks p4-puzhu21-v1.json with eligibleContexts [] = N-A byte-equal. No manifest policy: the last two P4 authority migrations used this pattern
reproducibility: impact.json comes from a provider-level override, not option A. They agree because propagation is single-pass on pre-states and 立券交易 enters it as H1-B only_ji, so keeping its 忌 cannot re-trigger puzhu:22 or any other line; Stage 4 migration diff is the proof
testsToRepoint: p4P21Stage1Projection.test.ts (pins N-A on 亥-丁酉/癸酉)
gates: mutation: removing an eligible context or adding 未-戊申/丙申 to the allowlist must fail
